hero.headline: Advertise SPARQL endpoint restrictions clearly.
hero.body: VoRD gives endpoint maintainers a compact, machine-readable way to publish live request, result, time, quota, and capacity restrictions for users and query engines.

resourcePanel.title: Canonical Resources
resourcePanel.body: Explore the generated reference and graph, then inspect the ontology, validation shapes, examples, and Vocabulary Usage Specification.

overviewCards.title: Endpoint Maintainers
overviewCards.body: Publish each important live restriction as a separate resource linked from sd:Service, with its metric, maximum value, unit, scope, enforcement, and hard/advisory status explicit.

overviewCards.title: Query Engine Developers
overviewCards.body: Use the generated vocabulary reference and graph to discover the terms and relationships needed to plan requests, adapt workloads, and interpret endpoint responses.

overviewCards.title: Users and Operators
overviewCards.body: Inspect concrete examples and published artifacts to understand when an endpoint may reject, truncate, queue, throttle, or otherwise constrain work.

customSections.title: What the Generator Publishes
customSections.body: The companion site is generated from the canonical VoRD ontology and configured repository resources. Generated pages are disposable build output; edit the vocabulary, examples, specification, or this configuration instead.
